# Clean Code Guidelines

- Follow KISS, DRY, YAGNI, and SOLID pragmatically.
- Prefer clear, maintainable solutions over unnecessary complexity.
- Avoid duplicating logic when a shared implementation is appropriate.
- Do not add functionality or abstractions that are not needed for the task.
- Keep each function, method, or class focused on one clear responsibility.
- Keep functions and methods to 50 lines or fewer, excluding comments and blank lines.
- Use descriptive and consistent names.
- Prefer explicit behavior over hidden side effects.
- Handle errors clearly.
- Avoid premature optimization.
- Keep changes focused on the requested task.
- Add or update relevant tests when behavior changes.
